quality_notes: ONS territorial, residence/production and footprint/consumption bases are kept separate.
ONS current and provisional atmospheric-emissions editions remain distinct.
ONS and DESNZ revision/correction history is preserved rather than silently replacing prior status.
DfT SAF and RTFO provisional/final chronology is explicitly guarded; future releases are not treated as observations.
Ofgem BUS applications, vouchers, grants and product eligibility remain scheme-administration evidence rather than measured GHG reductions.
DESNZ conversion factors and UK ETS factors are calculation/reporting tools, not direct parcel measurements.
Local-authority estimates, national transport statistics and consumption footprints are not assigned to individual parcels.
No individual parcel emissions value was inferred or produced.
